title: crataegus atrofusca
intro: Crataegus atrofusca, commonly known as the Chinese hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Crataegus atrofusca include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as a cardiotonic, improving heart function, and its potential to protect against cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Crataegus atrofusca include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligosaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
